cim: Create and Share a Dashboard in ChatGPT
kihagyva: P3: 45 pont, tendencia 25%, jóváhagyás után fordul
cim_eredeti: Create and Share a Dashboard in ChatGPT
szoveg_eredeti:
Turn your analysis into a dashboard your team can use. Building on the fictional Acme sales example, this walkthrough brings quarterly metrics and customer follow-ups into one view.

See how to inspect the data behind a chart, edit its appearance, ask questions about the numbers, and refine the dashboard with annotations. The video also covers refreshes, matching your branding, and sharing through Sites with connected data.

Sites data connections and viewer access:
https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sites/data-and-connections

Publishing and sharing a Site:
https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sites/publishing-and-sharing

Connection and refresh options depend on your workspace and the data source.

Part 4 of the Data Agent series.
